in_sanskrit.name: शेष
in_sanskrit.meaning: The Last, The End, The Remnant, The Residue
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Shesh is derived from the Sanskrit word शेष (śeṣa), which means 'the last, the end, the remnant, the residue'. It is also used to refer to the divine serpent Shesh Naag, who is the king of serpents and supports the universe on his hoods.

in_hindi.name: शेष
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Shesh is also used in the Hindi language and is written as शेष (śeṣa). It has the same meaning as in Sanskrit.

in_tamil.name: ஶேஷ
in_tamil.long_meaning: In the Tamil language, the name Shesh is written as ஶேஷ (śeṣa). The meaning of the name is 'The Last, The End'. It may also be associated with the divine serpent Shesh Naag in Hindu mythology.

in_telugu.name: శేష
in_telugu.meaning: The Last, The End, The Remnant
in_telugu.long_meaning: In the Telugu language, the name Shesh is written as శేష (śeṣa). The meaning of the name is 'The Last, The End, The Remnant'. It may also be associated with the divine serpent Shesh Naag in Hindu mythology.

in_marathi.name: Shesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे The End, The Remainder
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Refers to the divine serpent Shesha who supports the universe and is the embodiment of eternal wisdom and consciousness.
